title: Noor and the Oath
author: Tamsin Hartwell
blurb: Tamsin Ashgrove, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
